semanticInvariants: Every visual traces to a ledger event or a domain vector — no improvised visual without a source (invariant 14, contract.md Tier-0).
Refutation is not validation: falsified/refuted material must never render in the same visual language as supported material (driftwood path).
Hue is not a value: sea/scene colour must be a function of position and domain, never of a label or a rank.
The four channels stay separable in one frame — altitude (rootedness), currents (relation), still water colour (domain), depth (abstraction) must never share a channel (invariant 12).
leavability round-trip holds: problem.md / ledger.jsonl survive the opp parser unchanged.
